# PiTTy 0.6.43

## Claude account selection with cswap

- When `cswap` is installed, Settings offers **Claude usage account (cswap)**.
- Automatic selection reads the active Pi process's Claude profile instead of blindly displaying `~/.claude` usage.
- Select a managed account to display its usage and use its available credentials for **new Pi processes**. Restart PiTTy to apply the selection to an existing session.
- Display the selected account label alongside Claude's percentage in the status bar.
- No account is switched globally and no credentials are written by PiTTy. Missing inactive profiles are reported instead of silently using the wrong login.

## Probable prompt-cache rebuild warning

- Warn when the same Claude model unexpectedly loses a large cached prefix and rewrites at least 50k tokens.
- Ignore first/cold requests, model switches, and major prompt-size changes. Limit notifications to one per ten minutes per tab.
- The warning is diagnostic, not proof that a particular request was unnecessarily billed.

Run `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.43` to stage the release. It activates on your next PiTTy launch.
